grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: My Weekday Routine
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须使用短文中的原词，且不超过规定的词数。请根据短文内容作答。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。
passage:
A. I am Li Ming. I am a student. I live in Beijing. I get up at six thirty every day. I eat breakfast at seven. I go to school at seven thirty. I go to school by bus.

B. I have four classes in the morning. I have lunch at twelve. In the afternoon, I have two classes. I go home at four thirty. I do my homework at five. I have dinner at six thirty. I go to bed at ten.

C. On Saturdays, I don't go to school. I play football with my friends. On Sundays, I visit my grandparents. I like weekends.

questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty every day.

questions.explanation: 短文第一段说“I go to school by bus.”，所以选 By bus。
questions.evidence: I go to school by bus.

questions.explanation: 短文第二段说“I have four classes in the morning.”，所以选 Four classes。
questions.evidence: I have four classes in the morning.

questions.explanation: 短文第二段说“I have lunch at twelve.”，所以选 At twelve。

questions.prompt: 李明下午有几节课？请用数字填空。
questions.explanation: 短文第二段说“In the afternoon, I have two classes.”，所以填 two。
questions.evidence: In the afternoon, I have two classes.

questions.prompt: 李明几点回家？请用英文时间填空。
questions.explanation: 短文第二段说“I go home at four thirty.”，所以填 four thirty。
questions.evidence: I go home at four thirty.

options: He plays football with his friends.
answers: He plays football with his friends.

questions.evidence: On Saturdays, I don't go to school. I play football with my friends.

questions.explanation: 短文第三段说“On Sundays, I visit my grandparents.”，所以选 He visits his grandparents。
questions.evidence: On Sundays, I visit my grandparents.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，实义动词用原形，不加 -s。例如：I get up at six thirty. You go to school by bus. We play football. They like weekends.
grammar.example: I get up at six thirty every day.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 get，所以选 I get up at six。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty every day.

options: You go to school by bus.
You goes to school by bus.
You going to school by bus.
answers: You go to school by bus.
questions.explanation: 主语是 you，动词用原形 go，所以选 You go to school by bus。
questions.evidence: I go to school by bus.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 play，所以选 We play football。
questions.evidence: I play football with my friends.

questions.explanation: 主语是 they，动词用原形 like，所以选 They like weekends。
